candidates.passage: Odette walked the Saturday market with her list. The stall of old maps pulled her in; she turned the sheets slowly and forgot the time. The fish counter beside it made her wrinkle her nose and step wide around it. The brass band on the corner barely registered. She bought leeks and went home.
candidates.question: Odette has ten free minutes at the same market next week. Going only by the passage, where is she most likely to spend them?
candidates.right: at the stall of old maps
